page.title: Quest Creator OS
page.subtitle: Automate the machine loop. Spend the seat on design, spacing, and play feel.

machines.label: OMEN
machines.detail: Dual Intel Arc B70s and two displays make this the place for Valheim feel, Studio authorship, spatial judgment, and visual review. It is not the fleet's manual KVM.

machines.label: AM4
machines.detail: Online after the motherboard swap and available to the wider lab. Quest still integrates with platform services only through published packages and verified release files.

machines.label: i5
machines.detail: Offline nearby. Leave it off for creator-content and spatial work; start it only when the multiplayer event adapter itself changes.

environment.label: Repository baseline
environment.detail: Creator OS, safe-top Runtime composition, and bounded private Godbuild control are committed through c1ec660. This status snapshot adds the guild-dogfood requirements and first human-spaced capture.

environment.label: Creator Session
environment.detail: Session creator-first-godbuild-buildmode-20260824 completed on OMEN and ComfyQuestDemo: BuildOn and BuildOff returned correlated verified state, capture/inspect completed, and Close recorded the session closed with prior plugin/config bytes restored. The authored world was retained; its pre-session pair remains backed up.

environment.label: Runtime creator surface
environment.detail: The corrected live control plane passed Arm, armed/watching Status, Lab identity, and Disarm. A later hash-pinned launch passively captured the complete y=92 compact bar below the host band at the same 1026x740 viewport, restored minimized state without focus or input, and closed cleanly.

environment.label: Godbuild round trip
environment.detail: The first live human-spaced module contains 12 basic pieces with source hash e1e01ff675017bc6ed1d83868b3dcd5f9bb9a2f84089721dfa032fb79c537dfd. Capture and plan agree. Its declared terrain and portal exclusions make the saved world the playable release authority; replay remains fixture-proven and awaits use only when a reusable module needs cloning.

cold_load.title: Prepare one pinned Creator Session
cold_load.instruction: With Valheim closed, run Prepare once. Use its returned session id for every later operation; do not hand-copy files, relay console commands, or change worlds mid-session.
cold_load.verdict: Did this lane complete without turning Derek into the fleet's manual KVM?

creator_flow.title: Run the machine-owned creator session
creator_flow.summary: The six steps below are rendered from the checked-in Creator Session choreography, whose preconditions are ordered from Prepare through verified BuildOn, MATCH, BuildOff, and Close.
creator_flow.heading: Creator session loop

revision_flow.title: Move one guild idea through the whole product
revision_flow.summary: World and Studio authoring share one guild, quest, revision, world, and run context. Observe, reset, and rerun close the loop before release instead of consuming a new manual setup lap.
revision_flow.source_sequence: Imagine -> Author in the world and Studio -> Rehearse -> Play -> Observe -> Revise -> Reset -> Run again -> Release
revision_flow.suggested_edit: Build portfolio hierarchy, named live anchors, scoped reset/rerun, and saved-world bundling before asking for another seat lap; then use the uphill clearing as First Portal stage two.

phase3_lap.title: Parked Phase 3 exit lap
phase3_lap.summary: This remains a valid, source-derived five-step lap with exactly three human verdicts. Batch it into a later creative sitting; do not interrupt Creator OS construction for it.

decisions.title: Seat capacity
decisions.question: What work is allowed to consume Derek's time at the keyboard?
decisions.recommendation: Only authored choices, spatial judgment, visual review, and play feel. Deployment, relays, capture transport, and proof belong to the machine loop.
decisions.source_contains: The seat is for spatial judgment

decisions.title: Runtime surface
decisions.question: Does the overhead bar replace the old F9 drawer?
decisions.recommendation: Yes. F9 expands or minimizes one always-present overhead bar; a single clamped alert anchor carries deadline or actionable warning state.

decisions.title: Playable world authority
decisions.question: Does Godbuild generation replace the saved guild world?
decisions.recommendation: No. The versioned saved world owns terrain, vegetation, portal topology, and authored spatial context. Godbuild capture is optional reusable module/source/diff authority only for its declared fields.
decisions.source_contains: the saved world is the playable release authority

decisions.title: Adoption path
decisions.question: Do notebook patterns or auto-generation come before guild authoring?
decisions.recommendation: No. Build the portfolio, anchors, reset/rerun, and world-release foundation; let real guild authoring earn palette, pattern, and generation work from observed need.
decisions.source_contains: They are not substitutes for the authored source

decisions.title: Fleet roles
decisions.question: When should the nearby i5 peer be powered on?
decisions.recommendation: Only when the multiplayer adapter changes. Content-only and spatial work stay on the Creator Session lane without a human relay between machines.
decisions.source_contains: i5 stays off for content-only and spatial work

commands.label: Prepare Creator Session
commands.detail: With Valheim closed: lease, build, backup, deploy, hash-pin, and open the private-world safety window.

commands.label: Verify session pins
commands.detail: Read-only validation of the lease, machine, world, session, and installed payload hashes.

commands.label: Enable private build mode
commands.detail: After entering the pinned private world: directly enable and verify no-cost/all-pieces plus god mode without a console relay.

commands.label: Capture a Godbuild
commands.detail: Capture and inspect once, then automatically import and drift-check the review bundle.

commands.label: Re-run standalone import
commands.detail: Optional standalone entrypoint for an external Lab capture; Creator Session Capture already runs it.

commands.label: Replay after review
commands.detail: Run check, build, and translation-independent diff; fail unless the result is MATCH.

commands.label: Disable private build mode
commands.detail: Before leaving the loaded world: disable and verify both no-cost/all-pieces and god mode.

commands.label: Close Creator Session
commands.detail: After BuildOff and quitting Valheim: clear private confirmation, restore exact prior bytes, and release the install-wide lease.

commands.label: Start Quest Studio
commands.detail: Open the four-stage Author, Rehearse, Play, Observe cockpit on the second display.

cautions: The Creator Session lease owns the shared Valheim installation. Do not run another deployment or Lab mutation beside it.
Rehearsal declares its own proof level, disclaimer, and limitations; it does not prove Unity, BepInEx, Harmony, or live mutation.
A screenshot or checkbox is orientation, not machine proof. Preserve request receipts, identity pins, capture hashes, and MATCH.
Close -Restore restores prior install bytes, not the authored world. Treat the backed-up world pair as recovery material until the world-bundle lifecycle is implemented.
The live control plane, y=92 compact bar, private BuildOn/BuildOff, and first capture are proven. Reserve the next seat session for guild authorship after the machine-owned foundation is ready.
